profile.headline: Software Developer | Web technologies and Data science | Passionate about continuous improvement
profile.summary: Software developer with 3+ years of experience in projects involving databases, object oriented programming in Java with Spring Framework for the backend, Angular 8 and ReactJS in the front-end and projects about data science using R language. Interested in web technologies and data science. Passionated and curious about teamwork, continuing to learn, share my knowledge and have an impact on the industry with my work and skills looking for becoming a change agent.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Created and modified scripts to migrate databases from postgres to oracle by using R language to divide the system into services and have easier queries and better response times.
- Created functions and stored procedures in SQL to give more functionality when the users modify the data.
- Implemented new functions in Java and created code reviews on Jira to optimize the behavior of the system in a research hospital.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Participated in the implementation of the WMS system on a big retail store in Mexico to decrease the delivery time of products in different stores.
- Improved process performance by using new functions created in the WMS.
- Designed reports for different processes in the system to reduce the use of paper or possible human mistakes.
- Obtained all the functional requirements’ client and configured JDA warehouse management system to generate faster and more efficient product flows within the warehouse.
- Led meetings with customers and users to discuss the project, scopes, changes, processes and operations.
- Created triggers and developed complex commands based on Oracle and Java to manipulate some functions to reduce times in receiving area and shipping area.
- Wrote project documentation, verified on site for any issue after go live and trained warehouse employees to reduce the number of errors in the customer support stage.

projects.title: Yucatecan people in USA using twitter
projects.description: Algorithm to analyze how many yucatecan people live in USA. It worked with R language being connected to Twitter API, to know where tweet was published and then this one found mayan words.
